exit_hint: Quit the app. Close the window to keep it running.
exit_hint_shortcut: Quit the app. Close to keep running; %{shortcut} to show again.
shortcut_unavailable: Shortcut unavailable; it may already be in use. Check shortcuts.show_window in config.toml or desktop shortcut settings, then exit and restart. You can still use the tray if available.
tray_unavailable: System tray unavailable. Check your desktop's tray support; the window and shortcut remain usable.
close_blocked: Neither the shortcut nor the tray is ready. Keep the window open, or choose Exit.
capture_no_text: No text available; original kept. Copy text and summon again, or paste here.
capture_missing_tool: Automatic text capture needs wl-paste. Install wl-clipboard, or paste here.
capture_unavailable: Text capture failed or timed out; original kept. Paste here or summon again.
source_keyboard_hint: Enter to translate · Shift+Enter for a new line
config_path_unavailable: Cannot locate the config directory. Set YERAVICH_CONFIG and restart.
config_missing: Config not found: %{path}. Follow the README to create it, then exit and restart.
config_read_error: Cannot read config: %{path}. Check file permissions and UTF-8 encoding, then restart.
config_create_error: Cannot create the default config: %{path}. Check directory permissions and free disk space, or set YERAVICH_CONFIG to an existing config, then restart.
config_invalid: Invalid config: %{path}. Check %{field}, then exit and restart.
translation_client_error: Cannot initialize the network client. Exit and restart.
translation_timeout: Translation timed out. Please try again.
translation_network_error: Cannot connect to the translation service or read its response. Check the network and endpoint.
translation_http_error: Translation service returned HTTP %{status}. Check the endpoint, model, API key or service quota.
translation_invalid_response: Incompatible response. Expected Chat Completions JSON.
translation_empty_response: The translation service returned no translation. Please try again.
selection_permission_hint: Allow reading selected text in other apps without copying. You can revoke access in System Settings.
capture_accessibility_required: Reading selections needs Accessibility access. Click “Selection access” and enable Yeravich in System Settings. You can copy text before summoning as a fallback.
capture_accessibility_settings: Could not open permission settings. Open System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility and enable Yeravich.
capture_selection_unavailable: The source app did not provide readable selected text, or the read failed or timed out. Tried the clipboard instead; copy the text and summon again.
